blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) has received at least 500 pieces of information related to the manhunt for Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said. “As I mentioned, there are no less than 500 [pieces of] information. These were properly validated; we went to the locations and conducted operations,” Nartatez said in a press briefing on Monday. The information came from various areas across Western and Eastern Mindanao, the Visayas, Southern Tagalog, and Northern and Central Luzon, the PNP chief said.
